text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic photographic studio character asset, natural skin pores and fine individual hair, realistic cotton and knit detail. Pure white seamless background, bright soft frontal daylight balanced fill, low shadows, realistic 50mm lens perspective, no plastic skin, no illustration or 3D, no text or labels or logos. Preserve individual face, skin tone and age from reference.  One original fictional adult man. Mediterranean-looking man with loose dark tight curls, light beard and mustache, small silver hoop earring, approachable sensual confidence, plain ivory tank top. Facial design: long oval face with broad chin, gentle curved brows, wide-set green-hazel eyes, straight narrow nose, wide thin-lipped smile, warm olive skin. Ivory ribbed tank top tucked into charcoal pleated trousers, brown belt and dark brown loafers. Athletic medium muscle mass, tall 185cm build. Exactly nine head-and-shoulders portraits of this ONE SAME person in a clean 3 by 3 equal panel expression grid, every face front-facing eye-level same scale and consistent face hair clothes. Row1 neutral, gentle closed-mouth smile, happy open smile; row2 surprise mouth O, worried frown, quiet sadness; row3 focused anger, skeptical raised eyebrow, playful small wink. Expressions clearly distinct but attractive and natural. Full hair and shoulders inside each cell. Square overall canvas. Narrow white gutters, no text.
